summary.one_liner: An "awesome" curated list of Mastodon resources, covering instances, clients, tools, libraries, hosting, guides, bots, and similar federated projects.
summary.what_it_does: This is a link list rather than software: it collects resources related to Mastodon, the decentralized microblogging network. It is organized into sections: Official resources, Instances, Statistics, People, Tools, Desktop Clients, Mobile Clients, Libraries, Servers (forks), Guides, Hosting, Similar Projects, and Bots. Each entry is a name with a one-line description, such as a federation statistics site, a browser extension, an iOS or Android client, or a managed hosting provider. The list points to external projects and does not contain their code.
use_cases: find a Mastodon client for desktop or mobile
look up Fediverse statistics and federation graphs
find libraries for building Mastodon apps or bots
find guides for new Mastodon users
find bots and tools for scheduling or automating toots
notable: Covers the whole Mastodon ecosystem, from instances and clients to hosting and bots
Lists Mastodon forks (Glitch Edition, Hometown, ecko) and similar Fediverse projects such as Pleroma and Friendica
Includes client libraries such as masto.js and go-mastodon
Groups entries by purpose so readers can jump to a section
caveats: Link list only; entries are not verified and may be outdated
Some entries are unofficial third-party services or hosting providers
Contains no installable software of its own
